routines.name: Morning
routines.description: Remembrance for the start of the day.

routines.name: Before sleep
routines.description: What the Prophet said and recited when going to bed.

routines.name: On waking
routines.description: On waking up, and on waking in the night.

routines.name: After salah
routines.description: At the end of each obligatory prayer.

routines.name: Through the day
routines.description: Adhkar the hadith count across the whole day, said at any time.

adhkar.title: Surah Al-Ikhlas
adhkar.arabic: قُلْ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدٌ ٱللَّهُ ٱلصَّمَدُ لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُۥ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌۢ
adhkar.translation: Say, "He is Allāh, [who is] One, Allāh, the Eternal Refuge. He neither begets nor is born, Nor is there to Him any equivalent."
adhkar.englishEdition: Saheeh International

quote: al-Mu'awwadhatan three times in the morning and evening; they will serve you for every purpose

adhkar.title: Surah Al-Falaq
adhkar.arabic: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلْفَلَقِ مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ وَمِن شَرِّ ٱلنَّفَّـٰثَـٰتِ فِى ٱلْعُقَدِ وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ
adhkar.translation: Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak From the evil of that which He created And from the evil of darkness when it settles And from the evil of the blowers in knots And from the evil of an envier when he envies."
adhkar.englishEdition: Saheeh International

quote: al-Mu'awwadhatan three times in the morning and evening; they will serve you for every purpose

adhkar.title: Surah An-Nas
adhkar.arabic: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلنَّاسِ مَلِكِ ٱلنَّاسِ إِلَـٰهِ ٱلنَّاسِ مِن شَرِّ ٱلْوَسْوَاسِ ٱلْخَنَّاسِ ٱلَّذِى يُوَسْوِسُ فِى صُدُورِ ٱلنَّاسِ مِنَ ٱلْجِنَّةِ وَٱلنَّاسِ
adhkar.translation: Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind, The Sovereign of mankind, The God of mankind, From the evil of the retreating whisperer - Who whispers [evil] into the breasts of mankind - From among the jinn and mankind".
adhkar.englishEdition: Saheeh International

quote: al-Mu'awwadhatan three times in the morning and evening; they will serve you for every purpose

adhkar.title: By You we enter the morning
adhkar.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا وَبِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا وَبِكَ نَحْيَا وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma bika aṣbaḥnā wa bika amsainā wa bika naḥyā wa bika namūtu wa ilaikal-maṣīr
adhkar.englishEdition: hadith-api English edition of Jami` at-Tirmidhi

quote: When one of you reached the morning, then let him say

adhkar.title: By You we enter the evening
adhkar.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا وَبِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا وَبِكَ نَحْيَا وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ وَإِلَيْكَ النُّشُورُ
adhkar.translation: O Allah, by You we enter the evening, and by You we enter the morning, and by You we live, and by You we die, and to You is the Resurrection
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma bika amsainā wa bika aṣbaḥnā wa bika naḥyā wa bika namūtu wa ilaikan-nushūr
adhkar.englishEdition: hadith-api English edition of Jami` at-Tirmidhi

quote: And when he reaches the evening let him say

adhkar.title: The kingdom belongs to Allah
adhkar.arabic: أَمْسَيْنَا وَأَمْسَى الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ … لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ اللَّهُمَّ أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ هَذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ هَذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهَا اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكَسَلِ وَسُوءِ الْكِبَرِ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ فِي النَّارِ وَعَذَابٍ فِي الْقَبْرِ
adhkar.translation: We entered upon evening and the whole Kingdom of Allah also entered upon evening and praise is due to Allah. There is no god but Allah, the One Who has no partner with Him. … His is the Sovereignty and Praise is due to Him, and He is Potent over everything. O Allah, I beg of Thee the good of this night and I seek refuge in Thee from the evil of this night and the evil which follows it. O Allah, I seek refuge in Thee from sloth, from the evil of vanity. O Allah, I seek refuge in Thee from torment in the Hell-Fire and from torment in the grave
adhkar.englishEdition: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui translation of Sahih Muslim

quote: when it was evening Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to supplicate

adhkar.title: Sayyid al-Istighfar, the best way to ask forgiveness
adhkar.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ، خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ، وَأَنَا عَلَى عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ، أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَىَّ وَأَبُوءُ لَكَ بِذَنْبِي، فَاغْفِرْ لِي، فَإِنَّهُ لاَ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ
adhkar.transliteration: Allahumma anta Rabbi la ilaha illa anta, Khalaqtani wa ana `Abduka, wa ana `ala `ahdika wa wa`dika mastata`tu, A`udhu bika min Sharri ma sana`tu, abu'u Laka bini`matika `alaiya, wa abu'u laka bidhanbi faghfir lee fa innahu la yaghfiru adhdhunuba illa anta
adhkar.englishEdition: Muhsin Khan translation of Sahih al-Bukhari
adhkar.note: The hadith says during the day and at night.

quote: If somebody recites it during the day with firm faith in it
if somebody recites it at night with firm faith in it

adhkar.title: For wellbeing in this world and the Hereafter
adhkar.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَافِيَةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالآخِرَةِ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي دِينِي وَدُنْيَاىَ وَأَهْلِي وَمَالِي اللَّهُمَّ اسْتُرْ عَوْرَتِي … وَآمِنْ رَوْعَاتِي اللَّهُمَّ احْفَظْنِي مِنْ بَيْنِ يَدَىَّ وَمِنْ خَلْفِي وَعَنْ يَمِينِي وَعَنْ شِمَالِي وَمِنْ فَوْقِي وَأَعُوذُ بِعَظَمَتِكَ أَنْ أُغْتَالَ مِنْ تَحْتِي
adhkar.translation: O Allah, I ask Thee for security in this world and in the Hereafter: O Allah! I ask Thee for forgiveness and security in my religion and my worldly affairs, in my family and my property; O Allah! conceal my fault or faults … and keep me safe from the things which I fear; O Allah! guard me in front of me and behind me, on my right hand and on my left, and from above me: and I seek in Thy greatness from receiving unexpected harm from below me.
adhkar.englishEdition: hadith-api English edition of Sunan Abi Dawud

quote: never failed to utter these supplications in the evening and in the morning

adhkar.title: Knower of the unseen and the seen
adhkar.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ عَالِمَ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ فَاطِرَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ رَبَّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَمَلِيكَهُ أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ نَفْسِي وَمِنْ شَرِّ الشَّيْطَانِ وَشِرْكِهِ
adhkar.translation: O Allah Knower of the Unseen and the Seen, Originator of the heavens and the earth, Lord of everything and its Possessor, I bear witness that there is none worthy of worship except You, I seek refuge from You from the evil of my soul and from the evil of Shaitan and his Shirk
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma `ālimal-ghaibi wash-shahādati fāṭiras-samāwāti wal-arḍ, rabba kulli shai’in wa malīkahu, ash-hadu an lā ilāha illā anta, a`ūdhu bika min sharri nafsī wa min sharrish-shaiṭāni washirkihi
adhkar.englishEdition: hadith-api English edition of Jami` at-Tirmidhi

quote: Say it when you reach morning, and evening, and when you go to bed.

adhkar.title: In the name of Allah, with whose name nothing harms
adhkar.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي لاَ يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَىْءٌ فِي الأَرْضِ وَلاَ فِي السَّمَاءِ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
adhkar.translation: In the name of Allah, when Whose name is mentioned nothing on Earth or in Heaven can cause harm, and He is the Hearer, the Knower
adhkar.englishEdition: hadith-api English edition of Sunan Abi Dawud

quote: If anyone says three times
he will not suffer sudden affliction till the morning, and if anyone says this in the morning, he will not suffer sudden affliction till the evening

adhkar.title: Subhan Allah wa bihamdihi
adhkar.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ
adhkar.translation: Hallowed be Allah and all praise is due to Him
adhkar.englishEdition: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui translation of Sahih Muslim

quote: He who recites in the morning and in the evening (these words):" Hallowed be Allah and all praise is due to Him" one hundred times

adhkar.title: Four words that outweigh a morning of dhikr
adhkar.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ عَدَدَ خَلْقِهِ وَرِضَا نَفْسِهِ وَزِنَةَ عَرْشِهِ وَمِدَادَ كَلِمَاتِهِ
adhkar.translation: Hallowed be Allah and praise is due to Him according to the number of His creation and according to the pleasure of His Self and according to the weight of His Throne and according to the ink (used in recording) words (for His Praise)
adhkar.englishEdition: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui translation of Sahih Muslim
adhkar.note: The Prophet said these words after the dawn prayer while Juwairiya sat in remembrance.

quote: came out from (her apartment) in the morning
I recited four words three times after I left you

adhkar.title: La ilaha illallah wahdahu, a hundred times in the day
adhkar.arabic: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
adhkar.translation: There is no god but Allah, the One, having no partner with Him. Sovereignty belongs to Him and all the praise is due to Him, and He is Potent over everything
adhkar.englishEdition: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui translation of Sahih Muslim

quote: one hundred times every day
that is a safeguard for him against the Satan on that day till evening

adhkar.title: Asking forgiveness, a hundred times in the day
adhkar.arabic: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ
adhkar.translation: I seek forgiveness from Allah
adhkar.englishEdition: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui translation of Sahih Muslim

quote: I seek forgiveness from Allah a hundred times a day

adhkar.title: Refuge in the perfect words of Allah
adhkar.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
adhkar.translation: I seek refuge in the Perfect Word of Allah from the evil of what He created
adhkar.englishEdition: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui translation of Sahih Muslim

quote: Had you recited these words in the evening

adhkar.title: Al-Ikhlas, Al-Falaq and An-Nas into cupped hands, then wipe over the body
adhkar.arabic:
قُلْ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدٌ ٱللَّهُ ٱلصَّمَدُ لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُۥ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌۢ
قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلْفَلَقِ مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ وَمِن شَرِّ ٱلنَّفَّـٰثَـٰتِ فِى ٱلْعُقَدِ وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ
قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلنَّاسِ مَلِكِ ٱلنَّاسِ إِلَـٰهِ ٱلنَّاسِ مِن شَرِّ ٱلْوَسْوَاسِ ٱلْخَنَّاسِ ٱلَّذِى يُوَسْوِسُ فِى صُدُورِ ٱلنَّاسِ مِنَ ٱلْجِنَّةِ وَٱلنَّاسِ
adhkar.translation:
Say, "He is Allāh, [who is] One, Allāh, the Eternal Refuge. He neither begets nor is born, Nor is there to Him any equivalent."
Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak From the evil of that which He created And from the evil of darkness when it settles And from the evil of the blowers in knots And from the evil of an envier when he envies."
Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind, The Sovereign of mankind, The God of mankind, From the evil of the retreating whisperer - Who whispers [evil] into the breasts of mankind - From among the jinn and mankind".
adhkar.englishEdition: Saheeh International

quote: he used to cup his hands together and blow over it after reciting Surat Al-Ikhlas, Surat Al-Falaq and Surat An-Nas, and then rub his hands over whatever parts of his body he was able to rub
He used to do that three times

adhkar.title: Ayat al-Kursi
adhkar.arabic: ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ٱلْحَىُّ ٱلْقَيُّومُ ۚ لَا تَأْخُذُهُۥ سِنَةٌ وَلَا نَوْمٌ ۚ لَّهُۥ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۗ مَن ذَا ٱلَّذِى يَشْفَعُ عِندَهُۥٓ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِۦ ۚ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ ۖ وَلَا يُحِيطُونَ بِشَىْءٍ مِّنْ عِلْمِهِۦٓ إِلَّا بِمَا شَآءَ ۚ وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ ۖ وَلَا يَـُٔودُهُۥ حِفْظُهُمَا ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَلِىُّ ٱلْعَظِيمُ
adhkar.translation: Allāh - there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Self-Sustaining. Neither drowsiness overtakes Him nor sleep. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Who is it that can intercede with Him except by His permission? He knows what is [presently] before them and what will be after them, and they encompass not a thing of His knowledge except for what He wills. His Kursī extends over the heavens and the earth, and their preservation tires Him not. And He is the Most High, the Most Great.
adhkar.englishEdition: Saheeh International
adhkar.note: Al-Bukhari gives this report without its full chain at this place (mu'allaq). In it the Prophet confirms that the advice is true.

quote: Whenever you go to bed, recite "Ayat-al-Kursi"
Allah will appoint a guard for you who will stay with you and no satan will come near you till morning
spoke the truth, although he is an absolute liar

adhkar.title: The last two verses of Al-Baqarah
adhkar.arabic: ءَامَنَ ٱلرَّسُولُ بِمَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْهِ مِن رَّبِّهِۦ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ ۚ كُلٌّ ءَامَنَ بِٱللَّهِ وَمَلَـٰٓئِكَتِهِۦ وَكُتُبِهِۦ وَرُسُلِهِۦ لَا نُفَرِّقُ بَيْنَ أَحَدٍ مِّن رُّسُلِهِۦ ۚ وَقَالُوا۟ سَمِعْنَا وَأَطَعْنَا ۖ غُفْرَانَكَ رَبَّنَا وَإِلَيْكَ ٱلْمَصِيرُ لَا يُكَلِّفُ ٱللَّهُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا ۚ لَهَا مَا كَسَبَتْ وَعَلَيْهَا مَا ٱكْتَسَبَتْ ۗ رَبَّنَا لَا تُؤَاخِذْنَآ إِن نَّسِينَآ أَوْ أَخْطَأْنَا ۚ رَبَّنَا وَلَا تَحْمِلْ عَلَيْنَآ إِصْرًا كَمَا حَمَلْتَهُۥ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِنَا ۚ رَبَّنَا وَلَا تُحَمِّلْنَا مَا لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِهِۦ ۖ وَٱعْفُ عَنَّا وَٱغْفِرْ لَنَا وَٱرْحَمْنَآ ۚ أَنتَ مَوْلَىٰنَا فَٱنصُرْنَا عَلَى ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ
adhkar.translation: The Messenger has believed in what was revealed to him from his Lord, and [so have] the believers. All of them have believed in Allāh and His angels and His books and His messengers, [saying], "We make no distinction between any of His messengers." And they say, "We hear and we obey. [We seek] Your forgiveness, our Lord, and to You is the [final] destination." Allāh does not charge a soul except [with that within] its capacity. It will have [the consequence of] what [good] it has gained, and it will bear [the consequence of] what [evil] it has earned. "Our Lord, do not impose blame upon us if we have forgotten or erred. Our Lord, and lay not upon us a burden like that which You laid upon those before us. Our Lord, and burden us not with that which we have no ability to bear. And pardon us; and forgive us; and have mercy upon us. You are our protector, so give us victory over the disbelieving people."
adhkar.englishEdition: Saheeh International
adhkar.note: The hadith says at night, not only at bedtime.

quote: If somebody recited the last two Verses of Surat Al-Baqara at night, that will be sufficient for him

adhkar.title: In Your name, my Lord, I lie down
adhkar.arabic: بِاسْمِكَ رَبِّ وَضَعْتُ جَنْبِي، وَبِكَ أَرْفَعُهُ، إِنْ أَمْسَكْتَ نَفْسِي فَارْحَمْهَا، وَإِنْ أَرْسَلْتَهَا فَاحْفَظْهَا بِمَا تَحْفَظُ بِهِ عِبَادَكَ الصَّالِحِينَ
adhkar.transliteration: Bismika Rabbi Wada`tu Janbi wa bika arfa'uhu, In amsakta nafsi farhamha wa in arsaltaha fahfazha bima tahfazu bihi ibadakas-salihin
adhkar.englishEdition: Muhsin Khan translation of Sahih al-Bukhari

quote: When anyone of you go to bed

adhkar.title: You created my soul
adhkar.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ خَلَقْتَ نَفْسِي وَأَنْتَ تَوَفَّاهَا لَكَ مَمَاتُهَا وَمَحْيَاهَا إِنْ أَحْيَيْتَهَا فَاحْفَظْهَا وَإِنْ أَمَتَّهَا فَاغْفِرْ لَهَا اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَافِيَةَ
adhkar.translation: O Allah, Thou created my being and it is for Thee to take it to its ultimate goal. And its death and life is due to Thee, and if Thou givest it life, safeguard it; and if Thou bringst death, grant it pardon. O Allah, I beg of Thee safety.
adhkar.englishEdition: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui translation of Sahih Muslim

quote: as he went to bed, he should say
from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)

adhkar.title: Guard me from Your punishment
adhkar.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ قِنِي عَذَابَكَ يَوْمَ تَبْعَثُ عِبَادَكَ
adhkar.translation: O Allah, guard me from Thy punishment on the day when Thou raisest up Thy servants
adhkar.englishEdition: hadith-api English edition of Sunan Abi Dawud

quote: When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) wanted to go to sleep, he put his right hand under his cheek and would then say three times

adhkar.title: Lord of the heavens and the earth
adhkar.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ السَّمَوَاتِ وَرَبَّ الأَرَضِينَ وَرَبَّنَا وَرَبَّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَفَالِقَ الْحَبِّ وَالنَّوَى وَمُنْزِلَ التَّوْرَاةِ وَالإِنْجِيلِ وَالْقُرْآنِ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ ذِي شَرٍّ أَنْتَ آخِذٌ بِنَاصِيَتِهِ أَنْتَ الأَوَّلُ فَلَيْسَ قَبْلَكَ شَيْءٌ وَأَنْتَ الآخِرُ فَلَيْسَ بَعْدَكَ شَيْءٌ وَالظَّاهِرُ فَلَيْسَ فَوْقَكَ شَيْءٌ وَالْبَاطِنُ فَلَيْسَ دُونَكَ شَيْءٌ اقْضِ عَنِّي الدَّيْنَ وَأَغْنِنِي مِنَ الْفَقْرِ
adhkar.translation: O Allah, Lord of the heavens and Lord of the earths, and our Lord, and the Lord of everything, splitter of the seed-grain and date-stone, and Revealer of the Tawrah and the Injil and the Qur’an. I seek refuge in You from the evil of every evil that You are holding by the forelock. You are the First, there is nothing before You, You are the Last, there is nothing after You, and Az-Zahir, there is nothing above you, and Al-Batin, there is nothing below You. Relieve me of my debt, and enrich me from poverty
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma rabbas-samāwati wa rabbal-arḍīna wa rabbanā, wa rabba kulli shai’in, fāliqal-ḥabbi wan-nawā, wa munzilat-Tawrāti wal-Injīli wal-Qur’ān. A`ūdhu bika sharri kulli dhi sharrin anta ākhidhun bināṣiyatihi, antal-Awwalu falaisa qablaka shai’un, wa antal-Ākhiru falaisa ba`daka shai’un, waẓ-Ẓāhiru falaisa fauqaka shai'un wal-Bātinu falaisa dūnaka shai’un, iqḍi `annid-daina wa aghninī minal-faqr
adhkar.englishEdition: hadith-api English edition of Jami` at-Tirmidhi

quote: used to order that when one of us went to sleep, he should say

adhkar.title: Praise to Allah who fed us and gave us shelter
adhkar.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنَا وَسَقَانَا وَكَفَانَا وَآوَانَا فَكَمْ مِمَّنْ لاَ كَافِيَ لَهُ وَلاَ مُئْوِيَ
adhkar.translation: Praise is due to Allah Who fed us, provided us drink, sufficed us and provided us with shelter, for many a people there is none to suffice and none to provide shelter
adhkar.englishEdition: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui translation of Sahih Muslim

quote: When you go to bed, say

adhkar.title: Allahu Akbar
adhkar.arabic: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
adhkar.translation: Allah is Greater
adhkar.englishEdition: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui translation of Sahih Muslim

quote: When you go to your bed, you should recite Takbir (Allah-o-Akbar) thirty-four times

adhkar.title: Subhan Allah
adhkar.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ
adhkar.translation: Hallowed be Allah
adhkar.englishEdition: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui translation of Sahih Muslim

quote: Tasbih (Subhan Allah) thirty-three times

adhkar.title: Alhamdulillah
adhkar.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ
adhkar.translation: Praise be to Allah
adhkar.englishEdition: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui translation of Sahih Muslim

quote: Tahmid (al-Hamdu li-Allah) thirty-three times

adhkar.title: In Your name I die and I live
adhkar.arabic: بِاسْمِكَ اللَّهُمَّ أَمُوتُ وَأَحْيَا
adhkar.translation: With Your name, O Allah, I die and I live
adhkar.englishEdition: Muhsin Khan translation of Sahih al-Bukhari

quote: Whenever the Prophet (ﷺ) intended to go to bed, he would recite

adhkar.title: The last words before sleep
adhkar.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَسْلَمْتُ وَجْهِي إِلَيْكَ، وَفَوَّضْتُ أَمْرِي إِلَيْكَ، وَأَلْجَأْتُ ظَهْرِي إِلَيْكَ، رَغْبَةً وَرَهْبَةً إِلَيْكَ، لاَ مَلْجَأَ وَلاَ مَنْجَا مِنْكَ إِلاَّ إِلَيْكَ، اللَّهُمَّ آمَنْتُ بِكِتَابِكَ الَّذِي أَنْزَلْتَ، وَبِنَبِيِّكَ الَّذِي أَرْسَلْتَ
adhkar.translation: O Allah! I surrender to You and entrust all my affairs to You and depend upon You for Your Blessings both with hope and fear of You. There is no fleeing from You, and there is no place of protection and safety except with You O Allah! I believe in Your Book (the Qur'an) which You have revealed and in Your Prophet (Muhammad) whom You have sent
adhkar.transliteration: Allahumma aslamtu wajhi ilaika, wa fauwadtu `Amri ilaika, wa alja'tu Zahri ilaika raghbatan wa rahbatan ilaika. La Malja'a wa la manja minka illa ilaika. Allahumma amantu bikitabika-l-ladhi anzalta wa bina-biyika-l ladhi arsalta
adhkar.englishEdition: Muhsin Khan translation of Sahih al-Bukhari

quote: Let the aforesaid words be your last utterance (before sleep).

adhkar.title: Praise to Allah who gave us life
adhkar.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَحْيَانَا بَعْدَ مَا أَمَاتَنَا، وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ
adhkar.translation: All the Praises are for Allah Who has made us alive after He made us die (sleep) and unto Him is the Resurrection
adhkar.transliteration: Al-hamdu lil-lahil-ladhi ahyana ba'da ma amatana; wa ilaihi an-nushur
adhkar.englishEdition: Muhsin Khan translation of Sahih al-Bukhari

quote: when he woke up from his sleep, he would say

adhkar.title: Waking in the night
adhkar.arabic: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ، وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ. الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، وَسُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ، وَلاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ، وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، وَلاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِاللَّهِ … اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي
adhkar.translation: None has the right to be worshipped but Allah. He is the Only One and has no partners . For Him is the Kingdom and all the praises are due for Him. He is Omnipotent. All the praises are for Allah. All the glories are for Allah. And none has the right to be worshipped but Allah, And Allah is Great And there is neither Might nor Power Except with Allah … O Allah! Forgive me
adhkar.transliteration: La ilaha il-lallah Wahdahu la Sharika lahu Lahu-lmulk, waLahu-l-hamd wahuwa 'ala kullishai'in Qadir. Al hamdu lil-lahi wa subhanal-lahi wa la-ilaha il-lal-lah wa-l-lahu akbar wa la hawla Wala Quwata il-la-bil-lah … Allahumma, Ighfir li
adhkar.englishEdition: Muhsin Khan translation of Sahih al-Bukhari

quote: Whoever gets up at night and says
he will be responded to

adhkar.title: Astaghfirullah
adhkar.arabic: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ
adhkar.translation: I beg forgiveness from Allah
adhkar.englishEdition: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui translation of Sahih Muslim

quote: When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) finished his prayer. He begged forgiveness three times
How is the seeking of forgiveness? He replied: You should say: I beg forgiveness from Allah

adhkar.title: You are Peace
adhkar.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ السَّلاَمُ وَمِنْكَ السَّلاَمُ تَبَارَكْتَ ذَا الْجَلاَلِ وَالإِكْرَامِ
adhkar.translation: O Allah! Thou art Peace, and peace comes from Thee; Blessed art Thou, O Possessor of Glory and Honour
adhkar.englishEdition: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui translation of Sahih Muslim

quote: When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) finished his prayer

adhkar.title: None can withhold what You give
adhkar.arabic: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ، وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهْوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، اللَّهُمَّ لاَ مَانِعَ لِمَا أَعْطَيْتَ، وَلاَ مُعْطِيَ لِمَا مَنَعْتَ، وَلاَ يَنْفَعُ ذَا الْجَدِّ مِنْكَ الْجَدُّ
adhkar.translation: There is no Deity but Allah, Alone, no Partner to Him. His is the Kingdom and all praise, and Omnipotent is He. O Allah! Nobody can hold back what you gave, nobody can give what You held back, and no struggler's effort can benefit against You
adhkar.transliteration: La ilaha illa l-lahu wahdahu la sharika lahu, lahu l-mulku wa lahu l-hamdu, wa huwa `ala kulli shay'in qadir. Allahumma la mani`a lima a`taita, wa la mu`tiya lima mana`ta, wa la yanfa`u dhal-jaddi minka l-jadd
adhkar.englishEdition: Muhsin Khan translation of Sahih al-Bukhari

quote: used to say after every compulsory prayer

adhkar.title: Sincere in devotion to Him
adhkar.arabic: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ لاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِاللَّهِ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَلاَ نَعْبُدُ إِلاَّ إِيَّاهُ لَهُ النِّعْمَةُ وَلَهُ الْفَضْلُ وَلَهُ الثَّنَاءُ الْحَسَنُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ الدِّينَ وَلَوْ كَرِهَ الْكَافِرُونَ
adhkar.translation: There is no god but Allah. He is alone. There is no partner with Him. Sovereignty belongs to Him and He is Potent over everything. There is no might or power except with Allah. There is no god but Allah and we do not worship but Him alone. To Him belong all bounties, to Him belongs all Grace, and to Him is worthy praise accorded. There is no god but Allah, to Whom we are sincere in devotion, even though the unbelievers should disapprove it.
adhkar.englishEdition: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui translation of Sahih Muslim

quote: He (the Holy Prophet) uttered it at the end of every (obligatory) prayer

adhkar.title: Subhan Allah
adhkar.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ
adhkar.translation: Hallowed be Allah
adhkar.englishEdition: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui translation of Sahih Muslim

quote: If anyone extols Allah after every prayer thirty-three times

adhkar.title: Alhamdulillah
adhkar.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ
adhkar.translation: Praise be to Allah
adhkar.englishEdition: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui translation of Sahih Muslim

quote: and praises Allah thirty-three times

adhkar.title: Allahu Akbar
adhkar.arabic: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
adhkar.translation: Allah is Greater
adhkar.englishEdition: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui translation of Sahih Muslim

quote: and declares His Greatness thirty-three times, ninety-nine times in all

adhkar.title: To complete a hundred
adhkar.arabic: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
adhkar.translation: There is no god but Allah, having no partner with Him, to Him belongs sovereignty and to Him is praise due, and He is Potent over everything
adhkar.englishEdition: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui translation of Sahih Muslim

quote: and says to complete a hundred
his sins will be forgiven even If these are as abundant as the foam of the sea

adhkar.title: Help me to remember You
adhkar.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَعِنِّي عَلَى ذِكْرِكَ وَشُكْرِكَ وَحُسْنِ عِبَادَتِكَ
adhkar.translation: O Allah, help me in remembering You, in giving You thanks, and worshipping You well.
adhkar.englishEdition: hadith-api English edition of Sunan Abi Dawud

quote: Never leave to recite this supplication after every (prescribed) prayer

adhkar.title: Refuge from cowardice and the trials of the world
adhkar.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْجُبْنِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ أُرَدَّ إِلَى أَرْذَلِ الْعُمُرِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ فِتْنَةِ الدُّنْيَا، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ
adhkar.translation: O Allah! I seek refuge with You from cowardice, and seek refuge with You from being brought back to a bad stage of old life and seek refuge with You from the afflictions of the world, and seek refuge with You from the punishments in the grave
adhkar.englishEdition: Muhsin Khan translation of Sahih al-Bukhari
adhkar.note: The Arabic dubur as-salah can mean the last part of the prayer or right after it; scholars differ.

quote: used to seek Refuge with Allah from them (i.e. the evils) at the end of every prayer

adhkar.title: Surah Al-Ikhlas
adhkar.arabic: قُلْ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدٌ ٱللَّهُ ٱلصَّمَدُ لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُۥ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌۢ
adhkar.translation: Say, "He is Allāh, [who is] One, Allāh, the Eternal Refuge. He neither begets nor is born, Nor is there to Him any equivalent."
adhkar.englishEdition: Saheeh International
adhkar.note: The Arabic says al-mu'awwidhat, a plural. The English edition reads it as the last two surahs; many scholars include Al-Ikhlas, so all three are listed.

quote: commanded me to recite Mu'awwidhatan (the last two surahs of the Qur'an) after every prayer

adhkar.title: Surah Al-Falaq
adhkar.arabic: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلْفَلَقِ مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ وَمِن شَرِّ ٱلنَّفَّـٰثَـٰتِ فِى ٱلْعُقَدِ وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ
adhkar.translation: Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak From the evil of that which He created And from the evil of darkness when it settles And from the evil of the blowers in knots And from the evil of an envier when he envies."
adhkar.englishEdition: Saheeh International
adhkar.note: The Arabic says al-mu'awwidhat, a plural. The English edition reads it as the last two surahs; many scholars include Al-Ikhlas, so all three are listed.

quote: commanded me to recite Mu'awwidhatan (the last two surahs of the Qur'an) after every prayer

adhkar.title: Surah An-Nas
adhkar.arabic: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلنَّاسِ مَلِكِ ٱلنَّاسِ إِلَـٰهِ ٱلنَّاسِ مِن شَرِّ ٱلْوَسْوَاسِ ٱلْخَنَّاسِ ٱلَّذِى يُوَسْوِسُ فِى صُدُورِ ٱلنَّاسِ مِنَ ٱلْجِنَّةِ وَٱلنَّاسِ
adhkar.translation: Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind, The Sovereign of mankind, The God of mankind, From the evil of the retreating whisperer - Who whispers [evil] into the breasts of mankind - From among the jinn and mankind".
adhkar.englishEdition: Saheeh International
adhkar.note: The Arabic says al-mu'awwidhat, a plural. The English edition reads it as the last two surahs; many scholars include Al-Ikhlas, so all three are listed.

quote: commanded me to recite Mu'awwidhatan (the last two surahs of the Qur'an) after every prayer
